scope: Implementation and compact extraction review of unchanged-solver five-arm finite-prefix joint refits. No new proof acceptance, production promotion, coverage or target qualification.

checks.fit_contract: Refit delegates to the original fit_prefix/choose_fit/solve. R2_H2 is only an internal gate alias to the TaylorRC_H2 object. Zero and alternating +/-0.05 prior-whitened starts, 60 rounds, original fixed centres, prior and declared support are unchanged.
checks.joint_uncertainty: QR of stacked identity prior and whitened likelihood rows gives C=L R^-1. Direct replay transports J through every previous state Jacobian. Canonical B=dx/dc and K=B^-1 L retain inverse-Q/rate coupling; augmented QR jointly reduces direct, RC/H defects and residuals. No independent covariance blocks or duplicated prior.
checks.convergence: Same-anchor selected-fit diagnostics remain explicitly local even when unresolved. Fit-to-fit, physical delta and forecast comparisons require both selected candidate and direct reference to converge.
checks.ownership_and_truth: Frozen registrations/manifests, dependencies, binaries, recipes, snapshots and regenerated observation digest are checked. Original factor/state controls are compared bitwise. Stimulus truth outputs are discarded; fitting uses observations and the frozen public prior/centre only.
checks.controls: Direct, TaylorRC_H2 and R5_H7 selected status/start/coordinates/root/diagnostics must match frozen controls exactly; all 18 saved controls passed.
checks.summary: Physical differences subtract direct physical readouts only after convergence gating. Compact extraction retains all attempts and bindings. Per-partition transport/forecast details remain in hash-bound raw cases; combined QR forecast readouts remain in compact output.

tests.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B - (independent native multi-chunk and finite-difference check)
assertions: Multi-chunk direct endpoint and F agree with one native evaluate call (atol 1e-13 endpoint, rtol 2e-11/atol 2e-12 F).
Multi-chunk QR covariance agrees with direct full rows (rtol 1e-7, atol 1e-11).
All four fields: feature Jacobian times L agrees with central finite differences at step 2e-6 (rtol 3e-6, atol 2e-7).
All four fields: transported Jacobian times L agrees with central finite differences (rtol 2e-5, atol 2e-8).
All four fields: full covariance from independent factor QR agrees with augmented partition QR (rtol 3e-6, atol 1e-10).

tests.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B - (independent support and convergence-gating check)
tests.support_cases: Each of four fields rejects H-plus log-rate offsets -1.01/+1.01 and negative origin SOC.
tests.gating_cases: direct/candidate converged or unresolved crossed; candidate forecasts and qualified comparisons present iff both converge.

tests.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B - (summarize(run001), delta/gating assertions, byte comparison)

limits: No full sweep repeated by this implementation review; an independent result/reproduction review remains separately required.
Legacy normal-matrix solver/covariance preserved intentionally. New QR diagnostics do not establish calibrated coverage or nonlinear/global optimality.
Finite synthetic controls do not remove prior rest/off-centre failures, qualify aging/indefinite history, or prove complete Cortex-M23 memory/timing feasibility.
